reason: $59 a month is a lot on my budget when the library, parks and church group are free. And with a 4-year-old and a 10-month-old I'd be chasing them, not sitting with a coffee.
objection: I can get the same thing for free at storytime and the park, and I'd still be running after my kids the whole time.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap trial day, or a drop-in around $5 for both kids, that lets me see whether my 4-year-old actually plays on her own while I sit.
